title: Phantom HUB
features:
PHANTOM CORE — All-in-one combat script with anti-lag, exploits, and full GUI.

Features:

• WallCombo Spam — configurable speed and hit count

• Ability Spam — auto-use abilities on targets (ALL/NEAREST/SINGLE/SELECTED)

• KillAura — V1/V2/V3/Ult modes with closest target, ignore friends, ignore whitelist

• GodMode — Normal/Rank/V3/Ult modes with auto-respawn and CFrame pull

• AntiGodMode V2 — protection with teleport pull

• Hitbox Expander — client-side hitbox expansion with distance limit

• Movement — speed hack, jump power, fly, noclip, teleport

• Lagger — M1/M2/M3 spam with anti-lag protection

• ComboSpam — auto-combo on targets

Anti-Lag (7 systems, all auto-enable):

• Basic Antilagger — WallCombo, Particles, Lighting, Character

• AntiLagMob — mob ability spam blocking (CameraShake, Rocks, Destruction)

• FullAntiLag — visual optimization (materials, particles, sky, lighting, sounds)

• AntiLagFull — protection mode (hides lag instances, blocks Ability/Action remotes, anti-fling)

• AntiServerLagger — phantom mode for distant players + WallCombo VFX removal

• AntiLag Remote Blocker — disables incoming remote events via getconnections

• Instant Respawn — saves position on death, respawns instantly at same spot

Extras:

• ESP — player highlighting with name/health/distance

• Shaders — visual post-processing effects

• Auto parry / Auto block

• Config system with save/load and autosave

• Full keybind system — left-click to bind, right-click to unbind on any toggle/button

• F4 to toggle GUI

• Whitelist protection

GUI:

Modern dark theme with sidebar navigation, 11 tabs, drag & resize support.
